candidate_claims.statement: Rights of Man is a major break from the past of Europa Universalis.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: In short, Rights of Man is a major break from the past of Europa Universalis, just as that Revolutionary document was a break from the Ancien Régime.

candidate_claims.statement: This may mean you will need to learn new strategies as we toss out systems that were too rigid and left too little to your imagination and control.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: This may mean you will need to learn new strategies as we toss out systems that were too rigid and left too little to your imagination and control.

candidate_claims.statement: Monarchs now have traits that can help or hinder your progress.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Monarchs? They now have traits that can help or hinder your progress.

candidate_claims.statement: Technology was completely redone, casting aside the old location based system.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Technology? Completely redone, casting aside the old location based system.

candidate_claims.statement: There are many changes for governments and subjects, including new details for Revolutionary Republics and the Ottoman Empire.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Governments and subjects? So many changes including new details for Revolutionary Republics and the Ottoman Empire.

candidate_claims.statement: In Rights of Man, monarchs will now be given personalities that add bonuses or penalties to their empire.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: In Rights of Man, monarchs will now be given personalities that add bonuses or penalties to their empire.

candidate_claims.statement: A monarch's personality is comprised of a maximum of three characteristics, the vast majority of which will be positive, but some will be negative.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: A monarch's personality is comprised of a maximum of three characteristics, the vast majority of which will be positive, but some will be negative.

candidate_claims.statement: Your monarch starts with one aspect to his/her personality and additional characteristics will be added after both ten and twenty-five years of rule.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Your monarch starts with one aspect to his/her personality and additional characteristics will be added after both ten and twenty-five years of rule.

candidate_claims.statement: A monarch's personality is loosely tied to the monarch's abilities.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: A monarch's personality is loosely tied to the monarch's abilities.

candidate_claims.statement: Each personality characteristic is tied to events.
